description: Verification gate that runs your project's check command every time Claude tries to finish a turn, and sends Claude back to work while it fails. Put one line in .claude/verify.txt (e.g. `npm test && npx tsc --noEmit`, `pytest -q && ruff check .`); when the command exits non-zero, the last 40 lines of output go back to Claude with 'Fix the failures above, then finish. Do not weaken or skip tests.' Does nothing without a verify.txt (or LOCKED_IN_VERIFY env var) and never guesses a command. Skips when the git tree is clean or unchanged since the last passing run, lets Claude stop after 4 consecutive blocks so it cannot loop, kills the whole process tree on timeout (LOCKED_IN_VERIFY_TIMEOUT, default 300s), and exits 0 on any internal error so it never breaks a session. Complements tdd-gate: tdd-gate checks that a test exists before editing, verify-gate proves the tests pass before 'done'. Python 3 standard library only; Windows, macOS, Linux.
